body.text:
Homelab: weekend plan
Replace the failing fan in the NAS case, then run a ZFS scrub on tank and check the SMART report.
Also order a spare 6 TB disk before the next sale ends.

Shopping list
- [ ] oat milk
- [ ] coffee beans
- [x] batteries (AA)
- [ ] birthday card for Sam
- [ ] printer paper

Idea: nightly photo digest
Send a small Discord message each morning with 3 random photos from "on this day". Needs the Immich API key and a webhook. Keep it opt-in per person.

Router notes
DHCP range is 192.168.1.100-200. Static leases for the server (.50) and the printer (.40). Guest Wi-Fi is isolated from the LAN. Firmware updates: check first Sunday of the month.

Reading list
The Pragmatic Programmer, Designing Data-Intensive Applications (chapters 5-7), and that article on ZFS special vdevs Alex sent.

Trip to the coast, Sept
Good: the small bakery near the harbour, the evening ferry. Skip: the aquarium (crowded). Next time: book the cabin 3 months ahead.

Backup rules I follow
1. Three copies, two kinds of media, one off-site.
2. Test a restore every quarter.
3. Never trust a backup that was never restored.

Dashboard: things to try
- switch the design to Liquid Glass
- add a habit
- ask the Ask bar what the GPU is doing
- pin Notes to the phone tab bar
